title: Bucket-to-DynamoDB loader: cloud app browses synced metadata
description: apricity sync puts Model/<key>.json record files in the bucket, but the hosted app reads records from DynamoDB (design/storage.md §3.4). Add a loader (Lambda on S3 events or an explicit apricity sync step calling GraphQL) so a push from the Mac makes the metadata appear in the cloud app. Without it the cloud serves audio but not the analysis results. Prerequisite for the first cloud sync task (a48fb3).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Now the blocker for cloud Library/Score. Records are in the bucket (Model/<key>.json, pushed 2026-09-25) but DynamoDB tables are empty. Records are readable only by signed-in users, so end-to-end verification needs the sign-in task first (agents cannot create accounts); item shape (a.json as string, __typename, createdAt/updatedAt) must be checked against a real AppSync read.
